description: This file contains functions for retrieving default network routes, interfaces, and IP addresses on Linux systems, utilizing netlink sockets and syscall interfaces.

methods.name: GetDefaultHost
methods.description: Retrieves the first IP address of the machine from the routing table, preferring IPv4 for backward compatibility.

methods.name: chooseHost
methods.description: Selects a host IP address based on routing message and family, falling back to interface address if needed.

methods.name: getDefaultRoutes
methods.description: Fetches default network routes from the kernel routing table.

methods.name: getIfaceAddr
methods.description: Retrieves the network address of a specified interface by index and family.

methods.name: getIfaceLink
methods.description: Retrieves the link (interface) information by index.

methods.name: GetDefaultInterfaces
methods.description: Returns a map of interface names to their associated address families for default routes.

methods.name: parsePREFSRC
methods.description: Parses a netlink message to extract preferred source IP and output interface index.
